title: ChatGPT Images 2.6
description_en: Create, edit, and animate images with AI. Images 2.6 brings faster image generation, more precise editing, and native GIF creation to ChatGPT, Codex, and the API. Create looping animations, maintain character and product consistency across edits, export SVGs, and control generation complexity.

title: LiveReview
description_en: Free, Risk-Aware Code Review: Auto Approve Low-Risk Changes. Most AI review tools flag issues. LiveReview promises production results: fewer incidents, fewer rollbacks, less senior reviewer load. Every PR is risk-scored. The lowest-risk 30-50% are safely auto-approved; the risky ones go straight to the engineers who should see them. The approach is inspired by Meta's highly successful internal AI review system, where production incidents fell 50x and rollbacks 3x. LLM + incident-trained ML + code-graph analysis. Free and self-hostable.

title: Quest
description_en: Your personal AI advisor for a more intentional life. Most AI assistants help you get things done. Quest takes the time to understand your personality, values, ambitions, and motivations. More than just remembering conversations, it's a personal AI advisor that helps you reflect, navigate difficult choices, and make decisions aligned with who you are. Not another assistant telling you what to do, but a thoughtful advisor helping you find your own path.

title: Exa Monitors v2
description_en: Web search on a schedule that calls your agent, $2/1k runs. Exa Monitors v2 is web search on a schedule for AI agents. Describe what to watch, pick an interval, and Exa calls your webhook only when something new and relevant turns up, with a summary or JSON output and citations. Per Exa, v2 remembers what it has already sent, is quieter than v1, and costs $2 per 1k runs, down from $15. Watch prices, news, competitors, people and more. Python SDK and API available.

title: GPT‑6 Cyber
description_en: OpenAI’s cyber model, with vetted access for defenders. GPT-6 Cyber is OpenAI’s cybersecurity model, which per OpenAI pairs stronger security research with better alignment. It powered OpenAI’s Linux kernel research. Rated Critical in cybersecurity, it starts with a small group of vetted Daybreak Red customers, with identity checks, MFA and an application required. OpenAI says broader access is expected over the coming weeks. No public pricing yet.

title: Inkling 2 Small
description_en: A model that can see and refine what it builds. Inkling 2 Small is Thinking Machines Lab's new 594B-parameter MoE model with 17B active, built for long-horizon coding, visual tasks, and agents. Available on Tinker for inference and fine-tuning.

title: AXL
description_en: GTM copilot for AI product founders: 1,200+ actions via MCP. Capture leads, close sales & onboard customers in one system: pages, quizzes, webinars, courses, video hosting & streaming, email, chat, CRM, telephony & AI calls. No integrations to build & maintain. Every interaction enriches each lead's history. Our AI model, trained on 1M deals from AXL users, scores leads using 300+ signals to help your AI & sales team decide who to follow up with, when & how. Give ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor access to lead context & 1,200+ sales & marketing actions via MCP.

title: Google Omni 1.2 Flash
description_en: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: 15s AI video at $0.07 per second. Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash is Google DeepMind’s video generation and editing model, now generally available. Per Google, clips run up to 15 seconds, up from 10, and 720p costs $0.07 per second, 30% less than Omni 1.1. New: multi-turn editing without regenerating, steadier characters and styles, clearer lip-sync and smoother camera moves. Draft at 360p or 720p, then upscale to 1080p or 4K. In the Gemini API, Google Cloud, Flow and Vids.

title: Muse Realtime Avatar
description_en: Turn voice chats with Muse into live video calls. Muse Realtime Avatar gives Meta's Muse agent a face you can video chat with. Voice and video come from one speech stream, so lips, expressions, gestures and posture move with every word, and the reply starts in about 870 ms. Unlike talking-head avatars that only animate a face, it moves hands and full body too, and the character stays consistent from turn to turn. In Meta's live-call tests, raters preferred it 78% of the time over Runway Characters and 88% over HeyGen LiveAvatar.

title: NoMac
description_en: Your AI agent's own Mac, billed per minute. No subscription. Give Claude Code, Codex or Cursor its own Mac in the cloud: Xcode on Apple silicon, ready in about 30 seconds. Your agent builds your iOS app, runs it on an iPhone Simulator you can watch live, and ships it to TestFlight and the App Store. Then the Mac shuts down. Billed per minute from prepaid credit, no subscription: a whole build costs a few cents.

description_en:

Make a fist and they appear. Pinch and pull toward one to pick it, then just say what you need. When an agent asks for permission, pull right to allow or left to deny. Circle anything on your screen to hand it over, or ask a leader and its crew splits the work. Hand tracking and voice run on your computer, and everything also works with a mouse. Free on Mac and Windows.

title: Capnot
description_en: Make Screen Demos Clear, Even on Mute. Capnot puts captions, annotations and pointer tools on top of any app on your Mac, so a screen demo still makes sense with the sound off. Type a subtitle, or a speech bubble that follows your cursor, or just talk and it captions you live. Draw arrows, boxes and numbered steps, blur anything secret, then spotlight or magnify the part that matters. Every tool is one hotkey away and works with any screen recorder or screen share. No editing afterwards, no subscription.

title: Deal Pilot
description_en: AI SDR that books meetings in Japan, the US & SE Asia. Deal Pilot finds and verifies decision-makers by country and role, writes personalized cold email in English, Japanese or Chinese, and follows up until there's a meeting. 6.0% reply rate across 644 A/B-tested emails.

title: Sequence Tool
description_en: Edit with words: long recordings into polished stories. Sequence Tool is a native Mac app that turns long recordings into stories. Edit from text, prepare multiple angles, and export. It offers on-device transcription with optional CLI and MCP, designed to speed first-pass editing and surface key moments faster. Create what Matters.

title: Memorias
description_en: An AI biographer that turns your stories into a book. Memorias turns spoken life stories into a finished memoir book. You just talk: an AI biographer asks warm follow-up questions, session by session. Memorias transcribes everything, maps the people, places and years into a life timeline, and assembles chapters in your own words. Nothing invented: every chapter is checked against what you actually said. Add your photos, then export EPUB, PDF or DOCX. Pay-per-use credits, no subscription.

title: Standflow
description_en: Sit, stand, perch, and move on a rhythm from your menu bar. Standflow is a standing desk timer that lives in your Mac's menu bar. It guides you through a cycle of sitting, standing, perching on a tall stool, and short movement breaks, so you change posture often instead of sitting (or standing) all day. Start from a preset like Easy Start, based on the 20-8-2 guideline, or drag the cycle ring to build your own. Reminders can move on automatically or ask first. Track a daily standing goal and 7/30/90-day metrics. No account: your data stays on your Mac.

title: PacerTrip
description_en: Pick a marathon abroad. We plan the trip around race day.. Planning a marathon abroad means race dates, entry windows and fees on different sites, often not in your language. PacerTrip puts it in one app: 3,000+ races in 142 countries with entry dates and fees in your currency, a reminder the day before entry opens (big races can sell out on day one), stays sorted by distance to the start, an AI race-week itinerary, and a runner community for every race, auto-translated into your language. Free on iOS, Android and the web, in 44 languages.

title: Scriblive
description_en: Turn your kid's drawing into a 45-second cartoon. Snap a photo of your child's drawing and get a 45-second AI cartoon with its own plot, usually within an hour. No prompts, no editing, no stitching clips together. Just the drawing and, if you like, the story in your kid's own words.

title: Dietfit
description_en: AI calorie tracker that helps you eat smarter, not less. Cal AI made AI calorie tracking famous. We made it smarter. In our 30-plate test, Dietfit edged out Cal AI at 82%. But accuracy is just the start. Our interactive AI Scan lets you tap and edit ingredient pop-ups directly on your photo. And sure, Gemini and GPT can talk nutrition, but advice without your full context is still an educated guess. That's where Sara, our AI Coach, comes in, using your meal logs, goals, and activity to make guidance personal. There’s more than a calorie count.

title: Thumbwise
description_en: Organize iPhone apps from your Mac with your AI agent. Organizing apps on your iPhone sucks. Use Thumbwise to do it from your Mac instead. Read your iPhone layout over USB, place apps, folders and widgets exactly where you want them, preview, then apply. Your previous layout is backed up first, so you can always restore it. Optional: cut page swipes using your Screen Time data, or let your AI assistant arrange your layout to your exact specifications using the Thumbwise MCP. Free to download and try; $14.99 once to unlock Applying to your iPhone.

title: Moneta
description_en: Your work is the content. Moneta turns it into posts.. Distribution is half the job, and most makers skip it. Moneta keeps your workday in a folder on your Mac, and the agent you already use (Claude Code, Codex) turns it into build-in-public posts. Post every day without stopping to write. $20 once.

title: MicroNotch
description_en: On-device dictation and everyday tools in your Mac’s notch. MicroNotch brings dictation, clipboard history, files, music, notes, reminders and timers to your Mac’s notch. Code mode keeps supported AI coding sessions within reach. Choose from five themes, adjust text size independently and find a layout that suits you. MicroVoice transcribes English on your Mac after a model download, with no cloud transcription or API keys. Try it free for three days, no card required. Launch price: £14.99 once for two Macs, including all future updates.

title: mamitsu
description_en: An API and MCP that watches social videos and returns JSON. mamitsu is an API and MCP server that turns the content of a social media post into JSON. It watches the video, listens to the audio and reads the caption and post text, so the ingredients, products and steps in a post come back as data.

title: RankFast
description_en: Compare the best AI SEO tools for ranking fast in 2026. RankFast is an independent comparison of the best AI SEO tools for 2026. After testing 14 engines, Outrank ranked #1 for ranking speed, content quality, and cost. It uses real-time SERP analysis, keyword clustering, and bulk publishing so you can create a full month of ranking-ready content in an afternoon at ~$2–5 per article. Built for founders, agencies, and e-commerce brands who want organic traffic without a content team. Includes clear topics and practical guidance on ranking faster.

title: Wazza Pro
description_en: AI production pipeline for film and animation studios. For production studios: from pre-production to post-production, Wazza Pro runs inside your hybrid pipeline and delivers final pixels, meshes, VFX and sound as masters that pass delivery QC. Check a master against streamer delivery rules and get the fix for each failure, plan a film from script to boards, and run 40+ AI tools. Every step shows its cost before it runs. $5 free to start.

title: Agentmatica
description_en: Turn the questions shoppers ask into orders. Agentmatica is the sales and support agent for online stores. Paste your URL and it learns your pages and catalog. When a shopper asks which one to get, it answers from your content, shows the products as cards and suggests what goes with them. On Shopify and WooCommerce it builds the cart and hands over a checkout link. It handles shipping, returns and order questions too, and you can coach it privately, take over any chat and hand it back.

title: Maskink
description_en: Redact logs before AI sees them, restore values in the reply. Maskink replaces passwords, keys, IPs, hostnames and names in logs, scripts and chats with consistent placeholders. The AI sees only tokens; you read the reply with real values. Self-hosted, 95 editable rules, and a JSON API for your own apps. Interactive Demo: https://spaksu.github.io/maskink

title: Topped
description_en: Turn posts that already worked into posts for your app. Topped makes TikTok, Instagram and YouTube posts for app and SaaS founders, starting from a large collection of posts that already worked. For You keeps slideshow and video drafts ready for your product, and when one is based on someone else's post, you see that post's real views and likes. Approve, schedule, and see what every post actually got. Your own agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex) can run it too.

title: Wimi
description_en: Automatic Mac window tiling with point-and-click control. Wimi automatically tiles your Mac windows. Pick a layout, click live previews to switch, and drag windows into place. No config files or keyboard workflow to learn. Free to use, with a 30-day Pro trial.
